tools.name: search_founder_ventures
tools.description: Keyword search over the Founder Ventures library on bootstrapped B2B SaaS: growth playbooks, PLG glossary, case studies, tool comparisons, and original research. Returns titles, descriptions, and site-relative URLs.

tools.name: read_founder_ventures_page
tools.description: Fetch the markdown source of a Founder Ventures page. Pass a site-relative path such as `/` or `/glossary/product-led-growth`, typically one returned by search_founder_ventures.

tools.name: list_founder_events
tools.description: Curated startup and founder events in European tech cities, filtered for tech-founder relevance and refreshed daily. Omit `city` to list the supported cities.
